children: REX AMERICAN RESOURCES Corp reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $168.49M and diluted EPS of $1.06, driven by higher by‑product prices and recognition of clean fuel credits that boosted earnings versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales and revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to REX common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “diluted net income per share attributable to REX common shareholders”.
Revenue growth: Net sales rose about 6% in the quarter and roughly 3% year‑to‑date, supported by higher DDGS and corn oil prices while ethanol volumes remained flat.
Channel & product mix: Increased DDGS and corn oil pricing and sales improved by‑product margins.
Clean fuel credits: The company recognized $18.4M in the quarter and $26.0M year‑to‑date of 45Z clean fuel credits after updated rules, bolstering operational cash flow.

Operations and expansion: One Earth expansion was permitted to 175M gallons (plans pursue 200M) and CO2 capture/compression infrastructure was built; carbon capture and storage permits are in process.
Risks: Results remain sensitive to corn and natural gas prices, RIN waivers, export demand and limited hedging coverage (roughly four months).
